projection.instruction: Read `simulation_results` and `execution_results`. Return `post_execution_diagnostic` as an object decorating the existing simulated checklist without regenerating its items. `checklist` retains the same entries in the same order. Each `condition_id`, `expected`, and `simulated` preserves the original value, and `passed` preserves the simulation's Boolean prediction. `actual` describes the observed condition. `status` is exactly `pass`, `fail`, or `unverified`. `discrepancy` describes differences between expected and actual results, or is empty if none exists; it supersedes the earlier predicted discrepancy. `evidence` is an array of supporting observations or verification results. `overall_result` is `pass` only when every item passes, `fail` when a verified discrepancy exists, or `incomplete` when verification remains unresolved without an established failure.

inputs.verbatim_request: Using Terminal MCP @procedure build a comprehensive confined space fluid dynamics document focused on confined vortex dynamics, first decide a plan to consume relavent academic and patent information broadly in a organized manner, including categorization of materals to provide full breadth on the subject over a wide range of years and researchers, then decide what salient factors should be included as the main focus of the comprehensive document, etc.

user_intent.intent: Develop a comprehensive, source-traceable research document on confined vortex dynamics, beginning with an organized plan for broad longitudinal academic and patent acquisition and a reasoned selection of the most important physical factors.
objectives: Design a systematic, categorized ingestion workflow covering historic and recent scholarly research and patents across multiple researchers and device families.
Construct a comprehensive taxonomy of confined vortical flow geometries, mechanisms, regimes, methods, evidence, and outcomes.
Define a ranked set of salient governing factors and a technically defensible chapter architecture for the final document.
Build and persist a substantive first version of the document and research infrastructure using Terminal MCP Procedure.
Preserve source provenance, conflicting results, patent-claim distinctions, negative evidence, uncertainty, and a continuation plan.
constraints: Use the actual Terminal MCP Procedure alias as requested.
Consult the controlling CFD geometry/acoustic document and verbose project instructions.
Do not collapse confined vortices into vortex diodes or the existing inhalation dimensionless-threshold project.
Cover a broad historical span, multiple independent investigators, academic and patent lineages, and gas/liquid/multiphase systems.
Distinguish established physics and directly measured source results from inferences and unverified patent claims.
Choose the acquisition plan and salient focal factors before full content authoring.
user_intent.requested_outcome: A comprehensive foundational confined-vortex-dynamics research document accompanied by an organized source-acquisition and evidence-analysis plan, taxonomy, priority factors, citations, and exact further research tasks.

clarifying_questions.question: What historical start and present-day cutoff should define the academic and patent corpus?
Which fluid phases and confinement topologies must be covered to preserve breadth while prioritizing small passive devices?
How should seminal theory, direct experiments, numerical simulation, patents, and manufacturer disclosures be distinguished?
Which geometry, flow, and boundary-condition parameters are mandatory to extract from each retained study?
How should the corpus avoid overrepresenting one influential author, laboratory, standard geometry, or patent family?
How should conflicting onset, swirl, pressure-loss, instability, and acoustic results be compared without conflating definitions?
What source discovery channels, citation-chaining methods, patent databases, and duplicate-resolution rules are required?
How should the document rank universal governing mechanisms versus device-specific engineering examples?
What structure will preserve reproducible literature decisions, gaps, and future acquisition tasks?

question_answers.question: What historical start and present-day cutoff should define the academic and patent corpus?
question_answers.answer: Use foundational nineteenth-century circulation/vorticity theory through the current 2026-11-16 literature. Stratify pre-1900, 1900-1949, 1950-1969, 1970-1989, 1990-2009, 2010-2019, and 2020-2026. Source dates distinguish event, publication, priority and patent grant.

question_answers.question: Which fluid phases and confinement topologies must be covered to preserve breadth while prioritizing small passive devices?
question_answers.answer: Include single-phase gas and liquid, rotating-wall driven flows, two-phase/vapor/particle-laden cases as separate conditional branches; chambers (sphere, cylinder, annulus, cone, cavity), pipes/nozzles, tangential and opposed inlets, cyclone/hydrocyclone, vortex diode/valve, fluidic oscillators, swirler and vortex finder; mark open unconfined flows only as theory/analogue.

question_answers.question: How should seminal theory, direct experiments, numerical simulation, patents, and manufacturer disclosures be distinguished?
question_answers.answer: Source type and empirical proof are independent fields: original theory; peer-reviewed measurement; validated/unvalidated CFD; review/monograph; thesis/report; patent filing/claim/figure; vendor claim. Patents prove disclosure not achieved performance; confirmed measurements require independent evidence.

question_answers.question: Which geometry, flow, and boundary-condition parameters are mandatory to extract from each retained study?
question_answers.answer: Record coordinate system, cavity dimensions/shape, wall/end conditions, inlet orientation/count/final aperture/area, outlet topology, bypass/leakage/roughness, fluid properties and phases, forcing pressure/Q/transient history, downstream impedance/compliance, velocity/pressure/vorticity measures, uncertainty, Re/Swirl/Eu/St definitions, regime, onset/cessation, acoustic setup and baseline when applicable.

question_answers.question: How should the corpus avoid overrepresenting one influential author, laboratory, standard geometry, or patent family?
question_answers.answer: Cross-tabulate era, original investigators/laboratories, source lineage, topic/device family, methods, phase, geometry and contrary findings; cap excessive repeated geometry in synthesis without suppressing records; deduplicate patent families and versioned preprints; identify original source behind citation chains.

question_answers.question: How should conflicting onset, swirl, pressure-loss, instability, and acoustic results be compared without conflating definitions?
question_answers.answer: Preserve source-specific nondimensional velocity/length scales and measurement definitions; separate onsets, established states, cessation/hysteresis; normalize only under explicit mathematical equivalence; use conflicting-findings ledger showing whether contradiction is physics, geometry, phase, boundary condition or data quality; label acoustic mechanism only after controls.

question_answers.question: What source discovery channels, citation-chaining methods, patent databases, and duplicate-resolution rules are required?
question_answers.answer: Search Web of Science/Scopus when available, Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, NASA NTRS, NIST, OSTI, university repositories, Annual Reviews/JFM/Physics of Fluids/Experiments in Fluids; Google Patents, USPTO, Espacenet and WIPO; backward/forward chaining and inventor/assignee/citation-family expansion; store DOI, patent family, patent publication and accessible copy, full-text state.

question_answers.question: How should the document rank universal governing mechanisms versus device-specific engineering examples?
question_answers.answer: Rank physical conservation and geometry-boundary causal variables ahead of devices: angular-momentum budget, vorticity generation/transport, confinement, pressure outlet coupling, viscosity/Re, axial/radial transport, vortex breakdown/stability; next shear/competition, time variation, compressibility/multiphase/acoustics; use device chapters as tests of each mechanism.

question_answers.question: What structure will preserve reproducible literature decisions, gaps, and future acquisition tasks?
question_answers.answer: Persist an indexed Markdown master with version, evidence ledger, taxonomy, chronological/researcher index, search log, candidate/accepted/rejected registers, patent-family register, geometry/parameter matrix, contradictions, confidence, chapter claims, batch status and exact next task; maintain machine-readable CSV/JSON records and stable source keys alongside references.

inputs.verbatim_request: Using Terminal MCP @procedure build a comprehensive confined space fluid dynamics document focused on confined vortex dynamics, first decide a plan to consume relavent academic and patent information broadly in a organized manner, including categorization of materals to provide full breadth on the subject over a wide range of years and researchers, then decide what salient factors should be included as the main focus of the comprehensive document, etc.

user_intent.intent: Develop a comprehensive, source-traceable research document on confined vortex dynamics, beginning with an organized plan for broad longitudinal academic and patent acquisition and a reasoned selection of the most important physical factors.
objectives: Design a systematic, categorized ingestion workflow covering historic and recent scholarly research and patents across multiple researchers and device families.
Construct a comprehensive taxonomy of confined vortical flow geometries, mechanisms, regimes, methods, evidence, and outcomes.
Define a ranked set of salient governing factors and a technically defensible chapter architecture for the final document.
Build and persist a substantive first version of the document and research infrastructure using Terminal MCP Procedure.
Preserve source provenance, conflicting results, patent-claim distinctions, negative evidence, uncertainty, and a continuation plan.
constraints: Use the actual Terminal MCP Procedure alias as requested.
Consult the controlling CFD geometry/acoustic document and verbose project instructions.
Do not collapse confined vortices into vortex diodes or the existing inhalation dimensionless-threshold project.
Cover a broad historical span, multiple independent investigators, academic and patent lineages, and gas/liquid/multiphase systems.
Distinguish established physics and directly measured source results from inferences and unverified patent claims.
Choose the acquisition plan and salient focal factors before full content authoring.
user_intent.requested_outcome: A comprehensive foundational confined-vortex-dynamics research document accompanied by an organized source-acquisition and evidence-analysis plan, taxonomy, priority factors, citations, and exact further research tasks.

clarifying_questions.question: What historical start and present-day cutoff should define the academic and patent corpus?
Which fluid phases and confinement topologies must be covered to preserve breadth while prioritizing small passive devices?
How should seminal theory, direct experiments, numerical simulation, patents, and manufacturer disclosures be distinguished?
Which geometry, flow, and boundary-condition parameters are mandatory to extract from each retained study?
How should the corpus avoid overrepresenting one influential author, laboratory, standard geometry, or patent family?
How should conflicting onset, swirl, pressure-loss, instability, and acoustic results be compared without conflating definitions?
What source discovery channels, citation-chaining methods, patent databases, and duplicate-resolution rules are required?
How should the document rank universal governing mechanisms versus device-specific engineering examples?
What structure will preserve reproducible literature decisions, gaps, and future acquisition tasks?

question_answers.question: What historical start and present-day cutoff should define the academic and patent corpus?
question_answers.answer: Use foundational nineteenth-century circulation/vorticity theory through the current 2026-11-16 literature. Stratify pre-1900, 1900-1949, 1950-1969, 1970-1989, 1990-2009, 2010-2019, and 2020-2026. Source dates distinguish event, publication, priority and patent grant.

question_answers.question: Which fluid phases and confinement topologies must be covered to preserve breadth while prioritizing small passive devices?
question_answers.answer: Include single-phase gas and liquid, rotating-wall driven flows, two-phase/vapor/particle-laden cases as separate conditional branches; chambers (sphere, cylinder, annulus, cone, cavity), pipes/nozzles, tangential and opposed inlets, cyclone/hydrocyclone, vortex diode/valve, fluidic oscillators, swirler and vortex finder; mark open unconfined flows only as theory/analogue.

question_answers.question: How should seminal theory, direct experiments, numerical simulation, patents, and manufacturer disclosures be distinguished?
question_answers.answer: Source type and empirical proof are independent fields: original theory; peer-reviewed measurement; validated/unvalidated CFD; review/monograph; thesis/report; patent filing/claim/figure; vendor claim. Patents prove disclosure not achieved performance; confirmed measurements require independent evidence.

question_answers.question: Which geometry, flow, and boundary-condition parameters are mandatory to extract from each retained study?
question_answers.answer: Record coordinate system, cavity dimensions/shape, wall/end conditions, inlet orientation/count/final aperture/area, outlet topology, bypass/leakage/roughness, fluid properties and phases, forcing pressure/Q/transient history, downstream impedance/compliance, velocity/pressure/vorticity measures, uncertainty, Re/Swirl/Eu/St definitions, regime, onset/cessation, acoustic setup and baseline when applicable.

question_answers.question: How should the corpus avoid overrepresenting one influential author, laboratory, standard geometry, or patent family?
question_answers.answer: Cross-tabulate era, original investigators/laboratories, source lineage, topic/device family, methods, phase, geometry and contrary findings; cap excessive repeated geometry in synthesis without suppressing records; deduplicate patent families and versioned preprints; identify original source behind citation chains.

question_answers.question: How should conflicting onset, swirl, pressure-loss, instability, and acoustic results be compared without conflating definitions?
question_answers.answer: Preserve source-specific nondimensional velocity/length scales and measurement definitions; separate onsets, established states, cessation/hysteresis; normalize only under explicit mathematical equivalence; use conflicting-findings ledger showing whether contradiction is physics, geometry, phase, boundary condition or data quality; label acoustic mechanism only after controls.

question_answers.question: What source discovery channels, citation-chaining methods, patent databases, and duplicate-resolution rules are required?
question_answers.answer: Search Web of Science/Scopus when available, Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, NASA NTRS, NIST, OSTI, university repositories, Annual Reviews/JFM/Physics of Fluids/Experiments in Fluids; Google Patents, USPTO, Espacenet and WIPO; backward/forward chaining and inventor/assignee/citation-family expansion; store DOI, patent family, patent publication and accessible copy, full-text state.

question_answers.question: How should the document rank universal governing mechanisms versus device-specific engineering examples?
question_answers.answer: Rank physical conservation and geometry-boundary causal variables ahead of devices: angular-momentum budget, vorticity generation/transport, confinement, pressure outlet coupling, viscosity/Re, axial/radial transport, vortex breakdown/stability; next shear/competition, time variation, compressibility/multiphase/acoustics; use device chapters as tests of each mechanism.

question_answers.question: What structure will preserve reproducible literature decisions, gaps, and future acquisition tasks?
question_answers.answer: Persist an indexed Markdown master with version, evidence ledger, taxonomy, chronological/researcher index, search log, candidate/accepted/rejected registers, patent-family register, geometry/parameter matrix, contradictions, confidence, chapter claims, batch status and exact next task; maintain machine-readable CSV/JSON records and stable source keys alongside references.
